text: Course Object One-semester's time, two or three-semester progress Intensive Chinese program is an Carefully orchestrated course provided by the International College of Chinese Studies(ICCS), Shanghai Normal University. Based on the rule of second language learning, with scientific curriculum, large amount of information, highly-intensive training, various extracurrilar activities, pure Chinese environment, the course is to help students to make breakrough progress in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing in short term. HSK 3 will be reached in one semester and HSK 6 will be reached in two semesters. Target Group Students who want to improve their Chinese proficiency in short run
